title: Finite-stage rational and Karoubi coherence of completed exchange
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and the finite intermediate coefficient fields of [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Let $f:X\to S$, $g:T\to S$, $h:Y\to X$, $e:Y\to T$ form a Cartesian square [sbc-def-base-change-square]. Assume all four schemes are noetherian and finite-dimensional and $\ell$ is invertible on $S$. No smoothness or constructible landing hypothesis is imposed. For each field $E$ and corner $W$, put $\mathcal B_E(W)=D_{\mathrm{comp}}(W,\mathcal O_E)$, $\mathcal R_E(W)=\mathcal B_E(W)[1/\varpi_E]$, and $\mathcal C_E(W)=\Kar(\mathcal R_E(W))$, with the completed coefficient sheaves, raw scalar localizations and Karoubi conventions of [def-sbc-ambient-complete-coefficient-categories]. Use the actual integral completed operations $P_E^u=Lu^*_{\mathrm{comp},\mathcal O_E}$, $D_E^u=Ru_{*,\mathcal O_E}$ and their canonical natural exchange $\alpha_E^{\mathrm{int}}$ of [lem-sbc-completed-operations-linear-natural-exchange]. Write $C_W=C_{M/E,W}$ for the actual integral coefficient tensor of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension].

There are canonically specified additive raw rational and finite-stage Karoubi extensions of these operations and exchange, whose action for an integral linear functor $H$ is
$$H^{\mathrm{rat}}(u\otimes c)=H(u)\otimes c,\qquad H^{\mathrm{Kar}}(K,p)=(HK,H^{\mathrm{rat}}(p)).$$
A localized comparison $b:H\xrightarrow{\sim}J$ extends at $(K,p)$ with arrow $J(p)b_KH(p)$ and inverse $H(p)b_K^{-1}J(p)$. The raw exchange extends to the transformation with component $G_E(p)\alpha_E^{\mathrm{raw}}(K)F_E(p)$, where
$$F_E=P_E^fD_E^g,\qquad G_E=D_E^hP_E^e$$
now denote the extended functors $\mathcal C_E(T)\to\mathcal C_E(X)$; the same notation with superscript $\mathrm{raw}$ denotes their raw versions. Its value on $j_EK=(K,1)$ is exactly $j_E(\alpha_E^{\mathrm{raw}}(K))$, for the canonical identity-idempotent inclusion $j_E$.

More precisely, let the canonical integral scalar comparisons be
$$p^u:C_UP_E^u\xrightarrow{\sim}P_M^uC_V,\qquad d^u:C_VD_E^u\xrightarrow{\sim}D_M^uC_U\quad(u:U\to V).$$
Their integral composites $(P_M^f d^g)\circ(p^fD_E^g)$ and $(D_M^h p^e)\circ(d^hP_E^e)$ extend to comparisons
$$b^F_{M/E}:T^X_{M/E}F_E\xrightarrow{\sim}F_MT^T_{M/E},\qquad b^G_{M/E}:T^X_{M/E}G_E\xrightarrow{\sim}G_MT^T_{M/E}.$$
The individual operation comparisons and these composite comparisons satisfy the unit and tower equations for the scalar associators in [lem-sbc-coherent-pair-functor-descent], with identity coefficient transitions normalized as in [def-sbc-ambient-complete-coefficient-categories]. The extended canonical exchange satisfies, for every $K\in\mathcal C_E(T)$,
$$\alpha_M(T^T_{M/E}K)b^F_{M/E,K}=b^G_{M/E,K}T^X_{M/E}(\alpha_E(K)).$$
All these assertions also hold before the finite-stage Karoubi extension, on $\mathcal R_E$. The comparisons are the extensions of the specified integral scalar maps, including their tensor-unit normalizations at $M=E$; they are not arbitrary comparison isomorphisms. No invertibility of the exchange itself is asserted.
